lines.en: The air is damp. I fly low.
The flowers by the water grow thick.
I skim over the water.
There are droplets on my wings.
This marsh suits me well.
I go around a reed clump.
There are flowers in the mud too.
I fly slowly, to keep dry.
The damp makes my wings heavy.
I settle on a broad leaf.
I go back and forth over the shallows.
Frogs are calling here.
I follow the drainage ditch.
When the sun comes out, I speed up.
I look for flowers, and for dry spots.
Made it at last.
I dry my wings on a leaf.
The water is flat and still.
I open and close to shake off water.
I know the smell of a marsh.
Holding still costs the least.
There are dragonflies about.
There are fine lines on my wings.
I wait for the sun.
The wetland orchids have just opened.

lines.zh: 我停在菖蒲叶尖上晾翅。
lines.en: I perch on a reed tip to dry my wings.
I hide beneath a leaf.
The dew hasn't dried; my wingtips are cool.
Your boots are wet.
You are standing in the water.
I fly to your shoulder.
Do not swat. I do not bite.
There is damp on you.
You waded into the shallows; your boots are wet.
I know this patch.
I do not like being netted.
Your hand is very cold.
I will rest a moment and go.
I drop into the wet grass.
My wings are wet. I cannot fly.
Muddy water glues my wings.
A small wound like this is grave.
I tremble my wings.
Who stepped on me?
I crawl onto a leaf.
Still able to move.
The water is too cold.
Wet wings are heavy, so I fly slower.
That flower is wet.
I smell something sweet.
Lower your hand so I can smell.

lines.zh: 湿地湿气重，我的翅膀发沉。
lines.en: Wetland damp weighs my wings down.
The droplet rolled off.
Rain weighs my wings down.
Pollen is on my feet.
I will carry it to another flower.

lines.zh: 再舀一口花心里的雨水。
lines.en: One more sip of rain from the bloom's heart.

lines.zh: 湿地的水汽，沾在我翅上。
lines.en: Wetland mist clings to my wings.
You brushed my wing.
I spun once above the water.
I nearly fell into the water.
Fly higher, quickly.

lines.zh: 你溅起的水珠打湿我翅。
lines.en: Your splash soaks my wings.
Half my wing is wet.
Do not shove me by the water.
I flew to the other bank.
That bump was nothing.
Let me pass.
We chase each other over the water.
I fly level with it over the water.
We land on a reed together.
Our shadows are in the water.
This marsh is big enough.
The dew wets both our wings.
Orchids after rain smell just right.
The sun dries us.
We fly a stretch together.
Then we part.
What is that floating?
I grabbed at it.
Too wet to grip.
I land back on the leaf.

lines.zh: 泥里那块东西不是花蜜。
lines.en: That thing in the mud is no nectar.
That bloom sank into the murky water.
In the wet season, my wings go deeper in color.
That flower on the water is a reflection.

lines.zh: 水流把我的花粉冲散了。
lines.en: The current washes my pollen away.
I will not chase it.
Another bloom grows by the lily pad.
A white orchid stands behind the reeds.
On the far side of the water.
I skim the water toward that bloom.
The wind helps me.
The one beaded with dew.
It grows at the water's edge.
I fly in low.

lines.zh: 水汽把那朵花托得很高。
lines.en: The mist lifts that flower high.
One blink, and it was gone.
I come down toward the water.
My wing is wet again.
In the wet season, eyespots on my wings.
The flower is right there.
I correct my course.
The wind comes from the side.
I hold steady.
Almost there.

lines.zh: 我要停在滴水的花瓣上。
lines.en: I will land on a dripping petal.
Settled.

lines.zh: 我用湿翅膀甩了它一脸。
lines.en: I flicked wet wings in its face.
It waved a hand.
I am swatted into the water.
My wings are soaked.
I climb onto a leaf.
I cannot lift off.
Wait for them to dry.
This is no place to fight.
Rain beads still hang on my wings.
Never mind — my wings are still wet.
I come out of the damp air.
The marsh is cool.
First I find a leaf.
The flowers are thick here.
The water never stops.
I shake my damp wings.
The sun is not out yet.
There are orchids beyond.
Wet-season wings shine brightest.
I like this patch.
Fire touches my wet wing and it steams.
I fall into the mud.

lines.zh: 水漫过我的翅，我动不了。
lines.en: Water covers my wings and I cannot move.

lines.zh: 水花和气浪一起掀起来。
lines.en: Water and blast surge up together.
Something pierced my wing.
The water on my wings grew heavy.
The flowers have been spoiled by water.

lines.zh: 雷打在水上，光刺得我睁不开眼。
lines.en: Lightning hits the water and the glare blinds me.
With no damp air, my wings will dry out.
